paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.18% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (+1.10%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.36%). Brent crude changed +1.81% to 104.1. Gold changed +1.17% to 4,211.0. Bitcoin changed -4.39% to 82,683.1562. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.253%, a relative move of -0.45%. Among the firms tracked, ConocoPhillips (+6.11%) and 3i Group (-5.99%) moved the most.
